input: Research cold plunge therapy benefits and local spots

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The research could focus on general wellness benefits, athletic recovery, mental health, or medical/clinical evidence — knowing the angle changes what sources and depth are needed.
Whether this is for personal use, a recommendation to someone else, or a group (e.g. a sports team) changes how specific and tailored the findings need to be.
Knowing the user's city or region is essential to finding relevant local spots — without it, no location-specific research is possible.
Budget limits which venues are viable — some cold plunge facilities are premium spas, others are free (open water), and knowing this filters the local options meaningfully.
Some people want a social/spa setting, others prefer a DIY or outdoor option — this shapes which types of local spots to prioritise.
The output could be a personal reference note, a shareable document, a comparison table, or an action plan — knowing what 'done' looks like determines how to structure findings.
Whether the user wants a quick summary or a deep-dive resource, and whether they plan to try cold plunging soon or are in early exploration, affects the immediate next action.

gold.taskTitle: Research cold plunge therapy benefits and local spots
gold.taskDescription: Research the health and wellness benefits of cold plunge therapy and find local places where it can be experienced.

questions.title: Which specific benefits are you most interested in researching?
questions.description: Identify whether the focus is athletic recovery, mental health, immune function, general wellness, or clinical/medical evidence for cold plunge therapy.

questions.title: Are you researching this for yourself or someone else?
questions.description: Clarify who the research is ultimately for — personal use, a recommendation to a friend or client, or a group — to tailor the depth and framing of findings.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood should local spots be near?
questions.description: Get the user's location so that venue and facility research is geographically relevant and actionable.

questions.title: What is your budget per session at a facility?
questions.description: Understand the price range the user is comfortable with — from free outdoor spots to mid-range gyms to premium wellness spas — to filter local options appropriately.

questions.title: Do you prefer a spa setting, a gym, or an outdoor spot?
questions.description: Determine the type of environment the user gravitates toward so that local spot recommendations match their comfort and lifestyle preferences.

questions.title: What format should the final research output take?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a quick bullet-point summary, a structured document, a comparison table of local venues, or a step-by-step action plan.

questions.title: How soon are you looking to actually try a cold plunge?
questions.description: Understand the user's timeline — early exploration vs. planning a visit this week — to prioritise depth of research versus speed of finding a bookable local spot.
